Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck
and low back pain. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the
soft tissue ijnuries observed. Imaging and physical examination findings confirm
cervical and lumbar strain. No prior injury to these regions is known. The patient has
attended 34 visits to date. Treatment frequency and the range of services have grown
over several months, with new modalities added at successive stages, well beyond what
is typically required for this type of strain. Billing records reviewed for this
summary show no repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing management includes
active therapy and home exercise instruction, with reassessment planned to determine
whether further visits remain medically necessary.
